title: Integro-derivation Dzhumadildaev algebras: from the algebra of polynomials
summary: This paper introduces and investigates some properties of algebras constructed from the algebra of polynomials via derivation and integration operators using a process presented by Dzhumadildaev in a previous work. In particular, we discover new classes of infinite-dimensional simple conservative algebras and describe derivations of these algebras of ranks 1 and 2.
